title: KnowBench: Effort Reduction as a Unified, Deployment-Grounded Benchmark for Clinical AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.15794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical AI systems are evaluated with instruments built for research settings (reference-based similarity metrics and expert rubric panels) that measure resemblance to an artifact rather than reduction of a burden. We introduce KnowBench, pioneered by Knowtex, whose unifying metric is Effort Reduction (ER): the proportion of system-generated clinical work product accepted by the responsible clinician under expert and safety review. ER is defined once and instantiated per task across the administrative workload clinical AI automates: visit notes, diagnosis and billing codes, orders, EHR chart summarization, patient after-visit summaries, and clinical decision support. In every instantiation the construction is identical: the clinician's review-and-attestation event is the ground truth, every accepted unit is work the system completed, and every correction is residual effort returned to the clinician. translated_title: KnowBench：以工作量削减作为统一的、面向真实部署的临床AI基准
translated_abstract: 临床AI系统目前采用为研究环境设计的评估工具（基于参考答案的相似度指标和专家评分小组）进行评价，这些工具衡量的是输出与人工制品的相似程度，而非实际负担的削减程度。我们提出由Knowtex开创的KnowBench，其统一指标为工作量削减率：即在专家与安全审查下，由责任临床医生接受的系统生成临床工作产品所占的比例。ER只需定义一次，即可针对临床AI所自动化的各项行政工作流任务进行实例化，包括：就诊记录、诊断与计费编码、医嘱、电子病历图表摘要、患者就诊后总结以及临床决策支持。在每一种任务实例化中，构建方式都是一致的：临床医生的审查与确认事件即为真值标准，每一个被接受的单元都是系统完成的工作，而每一处修正则是返还给临床医生的残余工作量。本文的主要贡献……
tldr: 提出KnowBench基准，以“工作量削减率”——即系统生成的临床工作产品经专家与安全审查后被责任临床医生接受的比例——作为统一指标，衡量临床AI在真实部署中对各项行政工作流实际减少的医生负担。
en_tdlr: KnowBench introduces Effort Reduction (ER)—the proportion of system-generated clinical work accepted by the responsible clinician under expert and safety review—as a unified, deployment-grounded benchmark metric for clinical AI across all administrative tasks it automates.
